message: "users"."email" is set to NOT NULL, which scans the whole "users" table while blocking reads and writes.
why: SET NOT NULL holds an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock and checks every row, unless a validated CHECK constraint already proves the column has no NULLs.
safeAlternative: Add CHECK ("email" IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID, validate it in a separate migration, then SET NOT NULL (PostgreSQL skips the scan because the CHECK proves it) and drop the CHECK.
